label: Bible Study
prompt: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell _____.
verse: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
note: Stephen's last words echo Jesus' own prayer from the cross — forgiveness for his killers.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: _____ are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verse: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
note: After Thomas finally saw, Jesus blessed everyone who'd come after him — all who believe without seeing.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the _____ of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verse: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
note: At Zarephath's gate Elijah found a widow gathering sticks — and asked her, of all people, for a meal.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into _____: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verse: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
note: Isaiah's peace vision, and Micah 4:3 says it too — Joel 3:10 runs it backward as a call to war.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the _____.
verse: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
note: On the day of atonement one goat was offered, and the other, the 'scapegoat,' carried Israel's sins into the wilderness.
